support.colourPromiseBody: Every material is photographed in natural daylight, with one unedited reference frame published per colourway. If a delivered item differs materially from that reference, we collect it at our cost and replace or refund it in full. The Design Your Own preview is a rendered approximation and is not covered by this promise — see the honesty note in the configurator.
